project.objective: Identify every record indexed under the surname Czelusniak in FamilySearch's indexed Poland, Church Books collection (4135958, image group 004118433, covering the Wójtowa, Pagorzyna and Lipinki parishes), to find Marianna Czelusniak's parents and siblings.

questions.question: Which relatives of Marianna Czelusniak (I1) appear under the surname Czelusniak in FamilySearch's indexed Poland, Church Books collection (4135958, image group 004118433), covering the Wójtowa, Pagorzyna and Lipinki parishes?
questions.rationale: Marianna's parents and siblings are not yet in the tree. A survey of every occurrence of the surname across this indexed collection, rather than a search for her own marriage record alone, is the only way to surface them from the index.

items.jurisdiction: Wójtowa, Pagorzyna and Lipinki, Gorlice, Województwo Rzeszów, Polska
items.rationale: A survey of every occurrence of the surname Czelusniak across FamilySearch's indexed Poland, Church Books collection (4135958, image group 004118433, covering the Wójtowa, Pagorzyna and Lipinki parishes) — this collection is indexed and searchable with record_search, not a browse-only volume. Not a search for one person's own record: do not narrow with isPrincipal: true; the goal is every mention, so a parent or sibling named in another role is not missed.
